Choose a source language or use automatic detection, then select the target language. Photo, live camera and text translation run on this device after the required language packs are downloaded. Photo mode keeps the full frame; document modes enable paper detection.
Choose simple editable text, positioned text boxes, or page images. Text modes do not keep the original fonts, tables or page layout. All OCR runs on this device using your enabled languages.
